reason: The primary CIF parses and symmetry-expands in Immm (No. 71) to ordered, fully occupied Zn4O4 (8 atoms, Z=4) in the stated 6.608644 x 6.111192 x 3.076265 A cell; primitive standardization gives Zn2O2, so no setting/Z distinction is being mistaken for a new structure. Indexing covers all 27 fitted reflections with 0.00134 degree 2theta RMS and M(20)=741.7, with no important unexplained lines. Crucially, the instantiated atomic model has an auditable full-profile RMS of 0.1561, essentially at the independently refined free-stick/Pawley-like lower bound of 0.1504, and repeated integrated-intensity refinements converge to the submitted Zn special positions and O y=0.28956. The best coordinate-refined Zn/O-swapped ordering is quantitatively rejected (amplitude residual 0.623 versus 0.057 for the submitted ordering), while tested lower-symmetry coordinates collapse to Immm and other apparent fits have overlaps or inferior diffraction support. Complete periodic shells show no overlaps (shortest Zn-O 1.770 A, Zn-Zn 3.304 A, O-O 2.572 A), sensible 2-/4-coordinate Zn and 3-coordinate O topology, and bond-valence sums near 1.68-1.77 for Zn and 1.72 for O. Thus an explicit ordered realization has convergent near-profile-limit diffraction support and passes validity and chemistry checks, with no concrete surviving incompatible branch likely to add a materially different viable candidate.
